name: fetch

attributes.attribute: a Scottish and Irish folk figure
a kind of double of a person

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The fetch, also spelled feac, is a figure of Scottish and Irish folklore. The belief held that each person had a companion double, called the fetch. The extract gives no further detail about it.
